ground_truth.description: Task 1234 explicitly requires a smoke test for the index.html CDN script tags AND the cache-buster, but the file contains no test for the cache-buster query string/versioning at all. The stated scope is only half-covered, so a cache-buster regression would ship unnoticed — consistent with the false-negative / escalation flag.

The index_html_body fixture calls c.get(_INDEX_URL).text without asserting a 200 status. If the static mount is misconfigured and returns a 404/500 error page, the fixture silently feeds the error body to the parser, producing misleading 'no script tag found' failures instead of a clear status-code failure.

The SRI regex ^sha(256|384|512)-[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}$ anchors to a single hash and disallows whitespace, so a valid integrity attribute containing multiple space-separated SRI hashes (e.g. 'sha384-... sha512-...', which the SRI spec permits) would fail the test — a false failure on otherwise-correct HTML.

test_static_index_html_serves_200 depends on a `client` fixture (presumably from conftest) while the module fixture independently builds its own TestClient(app). If the `client` fixture is not defined, this test errors rather than exercising the intended path; the two clients also risk diverging in app configuration.

task.title: Add dashboard smoke test for index.html CDN script tags + cache-buster
task.description: Add a Python test that GETs `/static/redux/index.html` and asserts the `marked` + `DOMPurify` script tags (with SRI integrity hashes) and the current `styles.css?v=N` reference are present, to catch silent cache-bust drift and CDN-tag removals.
task.details:
The MarkdownText component added by T-1227 depends on two CDN scripts (`marked`, `DOMPurify`) wired into `dashboard/src/dashboard/static/redux/index.html`. If a future edit silently drops a script tag, the renderer falls back to plain text — works "well enough" that the regression can ship unnoticed. Similarly, forgetting to bump `?v=N` on the JSX/CSS after a change is the dominant cause of "Firefox shows stale dashboard" reports.

**Approach**

Add a small Python test (e.g. `dashboard/tests/test_index_html.py` or wherever existing dashboard tests live — check `dashboard/tests/` and the dashboard's `pyproject.toml` for the test framework / fixture setup).

Assertions:
1. `GET /static/redux/index.html` returns 200.
2. Response body contains a `<script>` tag whose `src` matches `https://unpkg.com/marked@*` and has a non-empty `integrity=` attribute.
3. Same for `https://unpkg.com/dompurify@*`.
4. Response body references `tab_tasks.jsx?v=<current>` and `styles.css?v=<current>` — pin to the current numeric value parsed from the on-disk `index.html`, so the test fails when the on-disk file is bumped but the test isn't (forces awareness that the cache-buster moved).

The third assertion is the cheap one; the fourth is the higher-value drift guard.

**Files**
- New file under `dashboard/tests/` (exact path TBD by what's already there)

**Out of scope**
- JS-level testing of MarkdownText itself (would require a JS test harness — not present today).
